description: We are Smart Farming, a team of passionate young innovators interested in space science, technology, coding, robotics, AI, and app development. We have hands-on experience in project smart farming We love solving real-world problems through creativity, teamwork, and innovation. We are looking for enthusiastic teammates skilled in programming, UI/UX design, data analysis, research, and presentation. Join us to explore ideas, build solutions, and make an impact through NASA Space Apps Challenge
